lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, with a distinct trapezoidal grouping of four primary maxima in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like configuration most visible in the center of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density constellation of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated towards the distal tip.
